svg.desc: 77 Homebrew formulae and 33 casks by category. Casks: Editors and IDEs 2, AI 3, Productivity 2, LaTeX 3, Research and graphics 2, Photography 1, Media and audio 2, Terminal 1, Networking and security 2, Browser and messaging 1, Window management 1, Menu bar 1, System maintenance 1, Fonts (prompt) 2, Fonts (text and display) 9.
